text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki heads into the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), armed with a running style that 
unleashes all her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she had overcome her past, her 
rivals looked back with eyes full of both 
anticipation and competitive fire.
